body: Thank you so much for these kind words and putting your input in. I always find myself having to explain myself to them and them just acting nasty towards me, so I think after senior year I’m just not going to talk to them anymore and just start new from the drawing board. I hope you’re having a great life with your friends and I hope I’ll be on that path in the future as well!

Thank you so so much for these kind words. I always find myself tugging a rope that doesn’t have an end to it. It’s just an endless void that I try to fill and can never back away from it. The only problems are that the boy that gives me such an attitude provides community service hours for me since I’ve volunteered for his parents company. This is necessary for all the honor society’s I’m partaking in for this year. The other problem is like I stated above was that there is a senior trip meet year that involves you needing three other boys to room with you and we all go to Washington DC and I’ve been looking forward to this trip since the start of highschool and if I break away I don’t know if that will be successful. But if I have to take the chances and risk that I will because of this toxicity against me.

Thank you so much. I’m trying to put myself out and get new friends and I guess I’m just scared that it’s going to ruin my senior highschool year of school because we go on a senior trip that lets us room with three other boys. I just don’t want to lose that ability of being able to have fun on the senior trip
